Maybe we should call get_budget_fiscal_year? No.

Better to call set_budget_limit directly. Then maybe confirm by retrieving something? There's no function to get the current budget limit. So we just set it.

Thus we call set_budget_limit with access_token=abc123xyz, budget_limit=20000.0.
